title: Composing exact peak–valley cells around a necklace forces P>P or P<P
statement: Composing the exact cells P --E^r--> V --O^a--> P' around a necklace forces the composite interval map to satisfy P_1>P_1 or P_1<P_1, without identifying a dangerous seam, for a reason that is not power_bound_word / power_bound_contracts / cycle_trailing_evens_lt / cycle_itinerary_formally_expanding / global_defect_identity / the closed exponent budget / the closed cycle-closure leftover-killer.
counterexamples: exact cells compose to T_w (25 --OOOEE--> 15, 365 --OOEOOE--> 1749); a cycle would have P=P
the one-sided product is 3^o/2^L: OOOEE is 27/32, leftover OOEOOEOOEOE is 2187/2048
real slack on OOOEE at peak 52214 sits in [7591, 9564] below 52214; leftover slack at 10^6 sits in [2.537e6, 2.554e6] above 10^6
365 --OOE--> 763 --OOE--> 1749 is expansion, not a P
mechanical OOE/OE interval at L=25781 is [986891, 25482877] and meets the start (cycle_closure)
notes: Phase 0 only. Reviewer slogan after seam sliding. Exact composition is T_w. The real sign is the closed exponent budget. Not a reopen of cycle closure, seam sliding, or the E^r block. No finance, no K=11, no L=55293, no floor raise. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no new Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: identities at 7/OE, 25/OOOEE, 365/OOE and OOEOOE; slack at leftover peaks 10^3 and 10^6; naive vs exact at 365; realized L=11 start 429 -> 646
